title: Patch v0.3.6: the perfect cards draw on every set that ships
notes: Core #97 Zephyrs and Classic+ #27 Zephrys Zealotism no longer name a set: both draw on every non-token card of every set that ships but their own (R1446), Meditative included, and a later set joins them the day it ships. Zephyrs may offer Zephrys Zealotism and Zealotism may deal Zephyrs. Only the pools and the words change.
